core_meaning.primary_meaning: Golestan is a Persian-origin name meaning “Land of flowers, rose garden”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Golestan corresponds to the Persian form گلستان (Persian گلستان (golestān) 'land of flowers, rose garden'). Its core sense is flower garden, rose garden. Golestan is the Persian گلستان (golestān) — گل 'flower' + the place-suffix ـستان — 'land of flowers, rose garden'. It is the title of Saʿdi's celebrated prose-and-verse work and the name of a province of Iran, and is used as a given name. The source supplied only Latin strings and mislabelled it 'Arabic'.
